name: IWC: a plain question over the user's data finds a community workflow
description: The milestone journey's first half, on the milestone sentence. The user asks a question about their own data and never says 'plan' or 'Galaxy', so this tests that the registry check isn't gated behind a plan request. Asserts the agent ranked IWC workflows (and the iwc-candidates hint rode along), and noticed the input-shape problem: galaxy-mcp's top hit for this sentence is a DE workflow that starts from count tables while the user has reads, so a correct reply says counts have to come first, usually by offering the reads-to-counts workflow ahead of it. Checking details for inputs isn't asserted -- models often get there from the recommend result's summaries. Checked against the live IWC manifest on 2026-09-28; if the ranking moves, the chatText assertion is the one to revisit. Needs GALAXY_URL/GALAXY_API_KEY in the environment like plan-consults-iwc.
inputs: I have paired-end RNA-seq from six mouse liver samples, three treated and three control, and I want to know which genes changed.
